Name: Type
Description: Selects the denoising method used to smooth noise while preserving overall features.

Flubs.Name: OnePass
Flubs.Description: Runs a single denoise pass for fast, moderate smoothing.

Flubs.Name: TwoPass
Flubs.Description: Runs a stronger two-stage denoise for cleaner results with better feature retention.

Flubs.Name: Pixels
Flubs.Description: Targets pixel-level speckle and stair-stepping artifacts, focusing on discrete noisy pixels.

Name: Amount
Description: Strength of the denoising effect (higher values smooth more, but can soften detail).

Name: Passes
Description: Number of denoise iterations to apply for the selected method.
